parameters.content:
## 1. Trigger & Load Qualified Leads
Runs nightly or manually. Pulls every verified lead that hasn't
had an email-finder pass yet.

## 2. Loop & Authenticate
Processes one lead at a time and refreshes the Snov.io OAuth
token before each domain search.

## 3. Snov.io Domain Search
Pulls every known email at the domain plus a list of people
who work there, with job titles.

## 4. Pick Best Contact & Save
Scores job titles — webmasters and office managers outrank
CEOs — and writes the best contact back to Notion.

## 5. Report to Slack
Posts how many leads were processed and how many got an email.
